title: A Clan of Two
subtitle: The Journey of Grogu
description: After foiling Moff Gideon's plans to capture Grogu for his nefarious purposes, the Mandalorian and Grogu decide to say goodbye to Nevarro for the time being. The Razor Crest blasts into space with Mando and Grogu on their sacred quest to return Grogu to the Jedi.
